A preliminary AUC calculation from previous data has an error-prone result of 0.863. A new extraction plan has been worked out: crop each data point individually to generate unique valid evidence refs, and I'm now mapping the coordinate range of Figure E. I have sorted out the value data of all target points in Figure E, clarified the coordinate ranges of the x and y axes and the distribution areas of positive and negative samples, and confirmed that there are overlapping points in the distribution area, which brings difficulties to identification. The previous extraction scheme is not feasible, and the subsequent grid identification scheme also fails to meet the requirements.

Previous extraction schemes have all been ruled out. I will next check the inventory, relevant files and images to find valid supporting data for the contract scoring task.
